description: Test suite for WebSocket functionality in Mattermost server, including connection, event handling, security, MFA enforcement, and status updates.

methods.name: TestWebSocketTrailingSlash
methods.description: Tests WebSocket connection with trailing slash in URL.

methods.name: TestWebSocketEvent
methods.description: Tests WebSocket event handling, including typing events and direct message creation.

methods.name: TestCreateDirectChannelWithSocket
methods.description: Tests creation of direct message channels over WebSocket.

methods.name: TestWebsocketOriginSecurity
methods.description: Validates WebSocket origin security and CORS policies.

methods.name: TestWebSocketReconnectRace
methods.description: Tests WebSocket reconnection handling under race conditions.

methods.name: TestWebSocketSendBinary
methods.description: Tests sending binary messages over WebSocket and status updates.

methods.name: TestWebSocketStatuses
methods.description: Verifies user status retrieval and updates via WebSocket.

methods.name: TestWebSocketPresence
methods.description: Tests presence updates and active channel/team/thread tracking.

methods.name: TestWebSocketUpgrade
methods.description: Checks WebSocket upgrade request handling and CORS blocking.

methods.name: TestValidateDisconnectErrCode
methods.description: Validates error code parsing and validation logic.

methods.name: enableMFAEnforcement
methods.description: Enables MFA enforcement in configuration for testing.

methods.name: setupUserWithMFA
methods.description: Sets up MFA for a user and returns the MFA secret.

methods.name: TestWebSocketMFAEnforcement
methods.description: Tests WebSocket behavior with MFA enforcement enabled, including blocked access for users without MFA and successful connection for users with MFA.
